description_en: Queries the list and metadata of cloud desktops across all regions
description_zh: 查询全地域的桌面列表及元数据
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktop-metadata --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --search-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7784180000 --group-id dg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --keyword ecd --creation-time-start 2025-01-01T12:00:00Z --operation-time-start 2025-01-01T12:00:00Z --include-desktop-group false --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --desktop-ids ecd-84mztzatmipf20000 --host-name ASW-2F-SRV-YXYZ-4.SHPTG --end-user-id test-user --network-interface-ip 192.168.1.1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktopMetadata

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to search
parameters.name: search_region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值：100默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. An empty value indicates that there are no more results
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始的token，nexttoken为空表示没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not yet available for use
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The time when the cloud computer was created. The time is in UTC and follows the format:
`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑创建的时间点。格式为UTC时间格式：
`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`
parameters.name: creation_time_start

parameters.help_en:
The start time of operations performed on the cloud computer. The time is in UTC and follows the format:
`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`
parameters.help_zh:
云电脑发生操作的开始时间。时间格式：
`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`
parameters.name: operation_time_start

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the response includes cloud computers in shared cloud computer groups
parameters.help_zh: 返回接口是否包含共享云电脑中的云电脑
parameters.name: include_desktop_group

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computer IDs
parameters.name: desktop_ids
